paper_title: The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful   Communication Datasets
caption: Single vs. multiple platforms as data sources over time. While most of the datasets are collected from a single source, around 2018 researchers are increasingly collecting data from multiple sources (i.e., two or more).
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets of hateful communication collected over time, comparing datasets sourced from a single platform versus those sourced from multiple platforms. The horizontal axis represents the year from 2012 to 2022, and the vertical axis displays the number of datasets, ranging from 0 to approximately 110, with tick labels spaced in increments of 20. The value axis is linear and displays the number of datasets, with units of “datasets”. The blue bars represent datasets sourced from a single platform, exhibiting a generally increasing trend from approximately 10 datasets in 2012 to approximately 80 datasets in 2021, with a peak of approximately 100 datasets in 2017.  The orange bars represent datasets sourced from multiple platforms (2+), starting with approximately 0 datasets in 2012, increasing to approximately 20 datasets in 2018, then rising to approximately 35 datasets in 2020, and increasing to approximately 45 datasets in 2022.  The bars are sorted in chronological order, and no bars are visually emphasized; the chart shows a consistent increase in the number of multiple-platform datasets between 2018 and 2022.
